# `company.pos_registers`

Point-of-sale registers: the fixed facts a POS sale takes from its till. Versioned; never deleted.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this record. |
| `version` | INTEGER | no | 1 | — | — | — | Optimistic-concurrency version of this record. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp when this record was created. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | User id recorded as creating this record. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface recorded for creation of this record. |
| `updated_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp of the latest update to this record. |
| `updated_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | User id recorded for the latest update to this record. |
| `updated_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface recorded for the latest update to this record. |
| `name` | VARCHAR(200) | no | — | — | — | — | Register display name (Main is made when POS is turned on). |
| `name_key` | VARCHAR(400) | no | — | unique | — | — | NFC-normalized and case-folded name key. |
| `site_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | inventory_sites.id | Inventory site its stock leaves from. |
| `deposit_account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | accounts.id | Account its takings are deposited to: Undeposited Funds (the default) or a bank account. |
| `payment_method_ids` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | JSON list of the payment-method ids it offers, in the order shown. |
| `walk_in_customer_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | customers.id | Customer a sale with no customer is recorded against; never shown on the POS screen or the receipt. |
| `refund_account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | accounts.id | Bank account cash refunds leave from; null until the company has one. |
| `receipt_width` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Receipt paper width in millimetres: 80 or 58. |
| `receipt_message` | VARCHAR(500) | yes | — | — | — | — | Line printed at the foot of every receipt; null for none. |
| `count_shifts` | BOOLEAN | no | — | — | — | — | Whether the drawer is counted in shifts (float, count, over/short). |
| `decoder_order` | VARCHAR(200) | yes | — | — | — | — | Camera decoder order for this register's devices (comma-separated names); null uses the host's scan_decoders. |
